re_006.name: Summary dates are computed
re_006.text: A summary task’s dates shall never be stored, only computed from its subtasks.

re_005.name: Nothing scheduled is cached
re_005.text: Early and late dates, slack, work and cost shall be recomputed on every edit; nothing is cached in the file.

re_001.name: A Flow operation applies once
re_001.text: Each operation shall be applied once per plan (appliedOps, 90 days); one for a missing task is skipped and recorded; an unknown kind is left for a version that knows it.

re_004.name: Flow never rewrites a plan
re_004.text: Flow shall only add a task or a timesheet line, never replace what is on screen.

re_003.name: Backups keep tombstones
re_003.text: Export everything shall include tombstones; Import everything shall merge by newer updatedAt and never delete.

re_002.name: A profile is a summary
re_002.text: Only Profiler’s stable fields shall be read; detail and raw answers are never copied into a plan.

re_007.name: Workspaces stay apart
re_007.text: Every screen shall count only the plans in the workspace in front.
